operatorProperties.code:
def process(mmc1, hyperactivated) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    clin = mmc1.copy()

    # ---- identify key columns ----
    # Histology
    hist_col = None
    for c in clin.columns:
        cl = c.strip().lower()
        if cl in {'histologic_type', 'histologic type'}:
            hist_col = c
            break
    if hist_col is None:
        cand = [c for c in clin.columns if 'histologic' in c.lower() and 'type' in c.lower()]
        hist_col = cand[0] if cand else None

    # CNV subtype class
    cnv_col = None
    # Prefer explicit class/subtype columns
    preferred = [c for c in clin.columns if 'cnv' in c.lower() and any(k in c.lower() for k in ['class', 'subtype', 'cluster', 'group'])]
    if preferred:
        # Prefer something like CNV_class exactly
        preferred_sorted = sorted(preferred, key=lambda x: (0 if x.strip().lower() == 'cnv_class' else 1, len(x)))
        cnv_col = preferred_sorted[0]
    else:
        # Fallback: any CNV column
        cnv_cols = [c for c in clin.columns if 'cnv' in c.lower()]
        cnv_col = cnv_cols[0] if cnv_cols else None

    # sample id column
    sid_col = None
    for c in ['idx', 'sample_id', 'Sample_ID', 'Proteomics_Participant_ID', 'Proteomics_Aliquot_ID']:
        if c in clin.columns:
            sid_col = c
            break

    if hist_col is None or cnv_col is None or sid_col is None:
        return pd.DataFrame([{
            'error': 'Could not identify required columns',
            'histologic_type_col': hist_col,
            'cnv_col': cnv_col,
            'sid_col': sid_col,
            'n_cols': clin.shape[1]
        }])

    # ---- filter to CNV-high endometrioid ----
    endo = clin[clin[hist_col].astype(str).str.contains('Endometrioid', case=False, na=False)].copy()
    cnv_series = endo[cnv_col].astype(str).str.strip()

    cnvhigh_mask = cnv_series.str.contains('cnv', case=False, na=False) & cnv_series.str.contains('high', case=False, na=False)
    # some files use just 'HIGH'
    if int(cnvhigh_mask.sum()) == 0:
        cnvhigh_mask = cnv_series.str.contains('high', case=False, na=False)

    endo_cnvhigh = endo[cnvhigh_mask].copy()

    # ---- map to hyperactivated sample ids ----
    ha = hyperactivated.copy()
    if 'sample_id' not in ha.columns or 'protein' not in ha.columns:
        return pd.DataFrame([{'error': 'hyperactivated.csv missing required columns', 'columns': ','.join(map(str, ha.columns))}])

    sample_ids = endo_cnvhigh[sid_col].astype(str).str.strip()

    ha_sub = ha[ha['sample_id'].astype(str).str.strip().isin(set(sample_ids))].copy()

    proteins = ha_sub[['protein']].dropna()
    proteins['gene_name'] = proteins['protein'].astype(str).str.strip()
    out = proteins[['gene_name']].drop_duplicates().sort_values('gene_name').reset_index(drop=True)

    if out.shape[0] == 0:
        return pd.DataFrame([{
            'error': 'No hyperactivated proteins matched CNV-high endometrioid sample IDs',
            'histologic_type_col': hist_col,
            'cnv_col': cnv_col,
            'sid_col': sid_col,
            'rows_total': int(clin.shape[0]),
            'rows_endometrioid': int(endo.shape[0]),
            'rows_cnvhigh_endometrioid': int(endo_cnvhigh.shape[0]),
            'example_cnv_col_values_endometrioid': '; '.join(list(cnv_series.dropna().unique()[:10])),
            'example_sample_ids_cnvhigh': '; '.join(list(sample_ids.head(10))),
            'example_sample_ids_hyperactivated': '; '.join(list(ha['sample_id'].astype(str).head(10)))
        }])

    return out

operators.customDisplayName: Filter mmc1 clinical metadata to CNV-high endometrioid samples using Histologic_type contains 'Endometrioid' and CNV subtype column preferentially chosen from fields containing 'cnv' + ('class'/'subtype'/'cluster'/'group') (prefer exact 'CNV_class'); then select rows where CNV subtype contains 'CNV' and 'HIGH' (fallback: contains 'high'). Use sample id column (prefer idx, else sample_id/Sample_ID/Proteomics_Participant_ID/Proteomics_Aliquot_ID) to subset hyperactivated.csv by sample_id, and return distinct sorted hyperactivated proteins as gene_name; if no matches, return 1-row diagnostic with counts and example values.
